lead.headline: Mirae Asset's $109B Digital Asset Push Anchors Institutional Tokenization Wave
lead.tldr: Traditional finance is no longer testing blockchain infrastructure—it is underwriting it as core operations. From Korean asset managers to US broker-dealers and central banks, the repricing of tokenization from experiment to line item is the day's throughline.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Mirae Asset maps out $109 billion digital asset push with Digital X: report
top_signals.summary: South Korean financial giant Mirae Asset is planning a massive digital asset expansion centered around its Digital X initiative. The firm aims to build a $109 billion business in the sector with a goal of achieving profitability by 2027.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Mirae Asset's $109 billion target by 2027 gives institutional investors a hard benchmark to evaluate tokenization platform revenue multiples against, and signals that Korean financial conglomerates are treating digital assets as a core profit center rather than a venture bet.

top_signals.title: XRP treasury firm Evernorth says SEC registration now effective, clearing way for Nasdaq listing
top_signals.summary: XRP treasury firm Evernorth has announced that its SEC registration is now effective, paving the way for a Nasdaq listing. The listing will be achieved through a merger with the SPAC firm Armada.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Evernorth's effective SEC registration and planned Nasdaq listing via SPAC merger creates a precedent for how XRP-linked treasuries can access public market capital, with implications for how we underwrite regulatory risk in crypto-native corporate structures.

top_signals.title: Virtu, Tradeweb complete onchain repo using Marshall Islands digital bond7m
top_signals.summary: Virtu and Tradeweb have successfully completed an on-chain repurchase agreement (repo) utilizing a digital bond issued by the Marshall Islands. This marks a significant step in the integration of traditional financial instruments with blockchain technology.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Virtu and Tradeweb's on-chain repo using a Marshall Islands digital bond demonstrates that systemically important market makers now execute secured financing on blockchain rails, which reprices the infrastructure stack away from pilot-phase discounts.

top_signals.title: Charles Schwab adda Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to nascent crypto platform
top_signals.summary: Charles Schwab is expanding its nascent crypto platform by adding support for Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink. This move extends the firm's direct trading offerings beyond the initial support for Bitcoin and Ether.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Charles Schwab's addition of Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink to its direct trading platform indicates that US retail brokerage infrastructure is expanding beyond Bitcoin and Ether based on client demand data, not speculation.

top_signals.title: Bank of England set for new innovation mandate covering stablecoins
top_signals.summary: The UK government is introducing a new innovation mandate for the Bank of England to modernize payment systems. This move is specifically aimed at advancing stablecoin regulations and enhancing cross-border cooperation with the United States.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Bank of England's new stablecoin innovation mandate, coupled with explicit US cross-border cooperation language, suggests that Anglo-American regulatory alignment on payment stablecoins is becoming a policy priority with timeline pressure.

deals.summary: Bitfinex Securities has successfully completed a $50 million tokenized capital raise for Alkemya. The funding was achieved through the issuance of ALKN, a tokenized security representing limited partnership interests.

BitGo has acquired NYDIG's institutional trading business to expand its derivatives offerings. The deal includes the transfer of approximately 30 employees and their existing institutional trading relationships.

on_the_radar.title: StarkWare tests quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction on mainnet
on_the_radar.summary: StarkWare has successfully tested a quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction on the mainnet. This development aims to future-proof Bitcoin against potential threats posed by quantum computing.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin treasury companies shed $80bn in value as business model unwinds
on_the_radar.summary: Companies that adopted Bitcoin as a primary treasury asset have seen a combined value loss of $80 billion as the strategy proves volatile. Many of these firms are now selling their holdings to return to their core business operations.

on_the_radar.title: Trump cost investors $4.7B through crypto ‘schemes’: Public Citizen32m, Trump cost investors $4.7B through crypto ‘schemes’: Public CitizenWhile investors in World Liberty Financial‘s USD1 stablecoin “haven’t suffered major losses,” many lost billions of dollars in other Trump ventures, according to Public Citizen.
on_the_radar.summary: Public Citizen reports that investors have lost approximately $4.7 billion through various cryptocurrency schemes associated with Donald Trump. While World Liberty Financial's USD1 stablecoin has not seen major losses, other ventures are cited as the primary source of these losses.

on_the_radar.title: Ethena Foundation proposes fee switch for ENA token buybacks among other updates
on_the_radar.summary: The Ethena Foundation has proposed a fee switch to implement buybacks of locked ENA tokens. Additionally, the foundation plans to end future monthly investor unlocks to alter the token's supply dynamics.

on_the_radar.title: Ripple Prime expands into US equity derivatives with Delta One business29m
on_the_radar.summary: Ripple Prime is expanding its offerings into the US equity derivatives market through the launch of its Delta One business. This move aims to bridge traditional finance and digital assets by providing streamlined access to equity-linked products.

on_the_radar.title: Chainalysis says global crypto taxable activity topped $457 billion in 2025
on_the_radar.summary: Chainalysis reports that global onchain taxable crypto activity reached an estimated $457 billion in 2025. The report highlights a significant gap in regulatory coverage, noting that the Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF) only covers 14% of this activity.

on_the_radar.title: Moonwell investigates lending market issue on Base as security firms flag multimillion-dollar exploit
on_the_radar.summary: Moonwell is investigating a lending market issue on the Base network following a multimillion-dollar exploit. Security firms estimate that an attacker manipulated the collateral price of MAMO to steal approximately $8.7 million.

on_the_radar.title: BlackRock's Mitchnick says bitcoin's risk-off narrative is 'the one to bet on' long term as rally consolidates near $80,000
on_the_radar.summary: BlackRock's Mitchnick suggests that Bitcoin's long-term value proposition as a 'risk-off' asset is the most compelling narrative as the price consolidates near $80,000. Analysts point to renewed spot ETF inflows and a decreasing correlation with equity markets as positive indicators.

worth_a_read.title: Building Corporations Onchain with Gabriel Shapiro
worth_a_read.note: Shapiro's framework for on-chain corporate structures directly informs how we evaluate Evernorth's SPAC path and whether tokenized governance can replace traditional entity formation for crypto-native treasuries.

linkedin_post: Mirae Asset wants $109 billion in digital assets profitable by 2027. That is not a pilot budget. That is a business line with headcount targets and board accountability. The Korean financial conglomerates are moving faster than the European banks we track. We should ask why. Schwab adding Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink to direct trading tells part of the story—retail demand is broadening beyond Bitcoin and Ether, and the infrastructure investment follows the fee pool. But the Virtu-Tradeweb repo on a Marshall Islands digital bond is the harder signal. Secured financing, not spot trading. Market makers doing on-chain collateral management as operational default. That is where the cost savings compound. The Dallas Fed warning on tokenized deposits destabilizing bank funding is the counterweight we are watching. If programmable deposits make retail funding flightier, credit costs rise and the net benefit of tokenization gets arbitraged away. The test: whether Mirae's 2027 profitability target holds if US funding markets reprice. We are underwriting tokenization infrastructure on the assumption that regulatory coordination—Bank of England's stablecoin mandate, the US Treasury's parallel moves—compresses the compliance discount faster than technology risk expands it. Evernorth's SEC registration going effective and its Nasdaq SPAC path is one confirmation. The next is whether Korean institutional flows show up in on-chain repo volumes, not just exchange balances. We will be watching Q3 repo data from Tradeweb.
